import ctypes
import numpy as np

def compute_sn(sorted_data, stride, work):
    # Load the dynamic libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Define the function prototype for gsl_stats_Sn_from_sorted_data
    gsl.gsl_stats_Sn_from_sorted_data.argtypes = [
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double),  # sorted_data
        ctypes.c_size_t,                  # stride
        ctypes.c_size_t,                  # n
        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)   # work
    ]
    gsl.gsl_stats_Sn_from_sorted_data.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Convert Python inputs to ctypes-compatible types
    n = len(sorted_data)
    if n < 2:
        raise ValueError("Input array must have at least two elements.")

    sorted_data_array = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*sorted_data)
    work_array = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*work)

    # Call the C function
    result = gsl.gsl_stats_Sn_from_sorted_data(
        sorted_data_array, ctypes.c_size_t(stride), ctypes.c_size_t(n), work_array
    )

    return result
